creator: Alexander Terp
description:
**Wanted:** Foreman's helper rows read "Read galaxy+ocean message" because Claude Code titles the session after Muster's wake and the pane takes that title as `Pane.name`. The owner accepted a design on 2026-11-06 (Foreman's mock-up foreman-helpers-mockup, direction B) that needs two things here.

1. Document `doing` as a standard `--fact` key, and have the Muster skill and adapters tell helpers to run `"$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --fact doing="..."` at the start and end of each stage of their brief, in about 40 characters. It lands in `Facts.other` today, so this adds no field. A hook cannot do it, because it sees only the wake and tool calls. Whether agents report reliably is untested.
2. Mark a name taken from the session rather than given with `pane new --name`, so a client can hide one written about a wake. The Muster and parallel-work skills should also tell makers to pass a `--name` that says the task.

Not checked: whether `report --clear` wipes the fact, read from the adapter's hooks and not run.
title: Helpers report what they are doing, and a name taken from the session is marked
